The module the *.json files in this directory were recorded from. They are the unmodified standard output of
`go test -json` (Go 1.27.3, the image of goprofile.Image, linux/amd64). Nothing here is compiled: the module is one text
file so that the failing tests in it are not live test files of this repository.

To record one again, extract the sections below into a directory (with an empty .suiteward/home/.keep and
.suiteward/tmp/.keep, which create the HOME and TMPDIR that go needs), pack the directory as a tar and run, in the pinned
image with no network, a read-only root and a tmpfs /work, the argv and the environment that goprofile.Command returns:

  tar -x -C /work && cd /work && exec go test -json -count=1 -shuffle=on -timeout=<t> -run '^(A|B)$' <packages>

with GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off GOFLAGS= GOPROXY=file:///work/.suiteward/proxy GOSUMDB=off and HOME, TMPDIR, GOCACHE and
GOMODCACHE under /work/.suiteward. The invocation of each fixture is in parse_test.go.

-- mixed/mixed.go --
package mixed
-- mixed/mixed_test.go --
package mixed

import "testing"

func TestPass(t *testing.T) {}

func TestFail(t *testing.T) { t.Fatal("broken") }

func TestSkip(t *testing.T) { t.Skip("not today") }

func TestSub(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("a", func(t *testing.T) {})
	t.Run("b", func(t *testing.T) {})
}

func TestSubFail(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("ok", func(t *testing.T) {})
	t.Run("bad", func(t *testing.T) { t.Error("bad") })
}
